column3: “a hundred and twenty years old” renders “a son of a hundred and twenty years.”
“commandments” is plural for the Hebrew singular “commandment.”
“before the LORD” renders “with the presence of the LORD”; “in their hearing” renders “in their ears.”
“as long as you live” renders “all the days you are alive.”
“the time for you to die is near” renders “your days have drawn near to die.”
“play the harlot with” renders “act as a prostitute after”; “them” is plural for the Hebrew singular “it.”
“them” renders the Hebrew singular “it” throughout; “our God … among us” renders “my God … in my midst.”
“they will do” and “they will turn” render Hebrew perfects “it has done” and “it has turned.”
NASB puts “for it shall not be forgotten … descendants” in parentheses; “intent” renders “inclination.”
“place it beside” renders “put it at the side of.”
“the latter days” renders “the end of the days.”
“in the hearing of” renders “in the ears of.”
